decision: Expose stable-only candidate checks as an explicit lower-compute fallback. Keep early as default; do not claim unchanged photo quality or view coverage when the fallback is enabled.

policy.effect: For video, only eligible candidates after existing pose dwell can run precise localization, reliability checks and enter selection; earlier raw candidates are not buffered.
policy.still_images: Python still-image capture is unaffected by video dwell timing.

method.default_parity: Complete old 3a5bb05 package loaded in isolation. Omit only equivalent default candidate_timing=early from its older strict schema; all model inputs/outputs, frame decisions and selected pixels compared.
method.fallback_full_input: All 2526 frames; instrumented logical model._run counts; every call a real cache miss. No timings from this run are used as speed evidence.
method.realtime: Serial early A / stable A / stable B / early B; B reverses video order. Original PTS, queue capacity 1, ORT 4 threads, 1000 us spin/backoff 8, OpenCV 1 thread, HighQoS verified, 15 model warmups. External load/frequency not locked; all eight planned trials retained.
method.pooled: Percentiles recomputed from concatenated individual frame timings; FPS = total processed / total elapsed.
method.counter_distinction: Offline counts model._run forwards; existing real-time model_calls counts detect API calls, including any early return.

timing_scope.micro_sampling: uniform across each whole video; sequential decode; interleaved videos
timing_scope.inference: prepared CPU tensor to returned CPU outputs, including GPU transfers/synchronization
timing_scope.capture_to_result: submission to result, including worker queue; excludes camera/driver
timing_scope.scheduled_to_result: scheduled video PTS to result, including producer lateness
timing_scope.excluded: preview/UI rendering, network, Re-ID, final image saving; models warm before replay
timing_scope.startup: new model sessions in an existing Python process; OS file cache not flushed

default_equivalence.method:
Check capture decisions against an earlier engine/refiner on every video frame.

The default keeps current adapters for compatibility with old engine revisions.
--isolated-reference loads the complete old package, including image sampling
and model adapters. Conditional empty outputs are accepted only when the original
scores prove no detection passes the same threshold. Scale-gated models must keep
every score and every eligible anchor bit-exact; only rejected heads may differ.
This checks numerical and decision parity, not throughput.

limits: The fallback can miss sharper early frames and brief side views; the user explicitly accepted it as a fallback, not the default.
No identity-labelled ReID accuracy evaluation and no actual low-end phone benchmark.
Network-call reduction is not an FPS speedup. Different real-time dropped frames change subsequent tracking, work and selected pictures.
Near-miss verification remains because it supplies temporal evidence; not all detector calls are deferred until pose dwell.
